exposure: Women with moderate to high GAD-7 scores
outcome: Mental health conditions during pregnancy and postpartum
finding: While pregnant women self-reported increased anxiety during the COVID-19 pandemic, this did not translate to increased rates of preterm birth, birth interventions, or mental health conditions postpartum.
mod_finding: This study investigated the impact of anxiety on birth outcomes, including preterm birth and instrumental/cesarean section birth, but did not primarily focus on comparing modes of delivery.
